sqlquery.from:
(select ccase.crmcasedetails_id ccasecrmcasedetails_id, ccase.caseNumberString ccasecaseNumberString, ccase.subject ccasesubject, caseorigin.name caseoriginname, casereason.name casereasonname, type.name typename, status.name statusname, priority.name priorityname, assignee.firstname||' '||assignee.lastname assignee, resolver.firstname||' '||resolver.lastname resolver, to_char(ccase.createdDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') receiveddate, to_char(ccase.lastUpdatedDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') updateddate, l.firstname||' '||l.lastname leadname, acc.name accname, contact.firstname||' '||contact.lastname contactname, opp.name oppname, emails.subject emailssubject, emails.toemail emailstoemail, emails.fromemail emailsfromemail, emailType.name emailTypename, ccase.deleted, ccase.intrash
from "$".crmcase ccase left join "$".crmcasedetails casedetails on casedetails.id = ccase.crmcasedetails_id left join "$".myuser assignee on ccase.owner = assignee.id left join "$".reference caseorigin on ccase.caseorigion = caseorigin.id left join "$".reference status on ccase.status = status.id left join "$".reference type on ccase.type = type.id left join "$".crmcontact l on ccase.lead_id = l.id left join "$".crmcontact contact on ccase.releatedto = contact.id left join "$".crmaccount acc on (ccase.crmaccount = acc.id or l.crmaccount=acc.id or contact.crmaccount=acc.id) left join "$".opportunity opp on ccase.opportunity = opp.id left join "$".reference priority on ccase.priority = priority.id left join "$".reference casereason on ccase.casereason = casereason.id left join "$".myuser resolver on ccase.resolver = resolver.id left join "$".caseemails emails on ccase.id = emails.crmcase left join "$".crmCaseDetails caseemaildetails on caseemaildetails.id = emails.crmcaseemaildetails_id left join "$".reference emailType on emails.type = emailType.id where ccase.deleted is not true and ccase.intrash is not true ) cases
